problem:
Problem description
- This is a single-period cutting-stock planning problem for a homogeneous steel reinforcement workshop.
- There is one raw stock material with length $$L$$ and a set of finished piece types indexed by $$p \in \mathcal{P}$$.
- Each piece type $$p$$ has required length $$\ell_p$$ and demand quantity $$d_p$$.
- The planning horizon is single-period, so the time set is $$\mathcal{T} = \{1\}$$.
- A feasible cutting pattern $$k \in \mathcal{K}$$ specifies how one raw bar can be cut into pieces of the available types while respecting the raw length $$L$$; any leftover length under that pattern is waste $$w_k$$.
- The planning goal is to choose how many raw bars follow each feasible pattern so that all demanded pieces are produced and total waste is minimized.
- All pieces have the same diameter, so only lengths and quantities matter in the plan.
- The workshop may use only nonnegative integer numbers of raw bars for each pattern.
- Every demand $$d_p$$ must be satisfied by the combined output of the chosen patterns.
- No cutting pattern may use more total piece length than the available raw bar length $$L$$.
- Waste is the unused length remaining after cutting a raw bar, and the objective is to minimize the total waste across all used raw bars.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_k$$: the number of raw bars cut according to feasible pattern $$k \in \mathcal{K}$$.
  - $$w_k$$: the waste produced by one raw bar under pattern $$k$$.
  - $$q_p$$: the total number of pieces of type $$p \in \mathcal{P}$$ produced by the chosen patterns.
  - $$Z$$: the total waste of the cutting plan.

Input Format
{
  "T": "Single-period planning horizon $$\mathcal{T} = \\{1\\}$$",
  "P": "Number of piece types, indexed by $$p \\in \\mathcal{P} = \\{1,\\dots,P\\}$$",
  "L": "Length of one raw stock bar",
  "ell": {
    "shape": "[$$P$$]",
    "meaning": "Required lengths $$\\ell_p$$ for each piece type $$p$$"
  },
  "d": {
    "shape": "[$$P$$]",
    "meaning": "Demand quantities $$d_p$$ for each piece type $$p$$"
  },
  "c_w": "Unit waste penalty $$c^{\\mathrm{w}}$$, used when waste is priced rather than measured directly"
}

Output Format
{
  "selected_patterns": [
    {
      "pattern_id": "$$k$$",
      "composition": {
        "p": "Number of pieces of type $$p$$ cut from one raw bar under pattern $$k$$"
      },
      "bars_used": "$$x_k$$",
      "waste_per_bar": "$$w_k$$"
    }
  ],
  "total_waste": "$$Z$$"
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "T": "$$1$$",
  "P": "$$2$$",
  "L": "$$10$$",
  "ell": ["$$3$$", "$$4$$"],
  "d": ["$$90$$", "$$60$$"],
  "c_w": "$$1$$"
}

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Number of planning periods in the horizon (single-period setting)

parameters.name: raw_stock_length
parameters.description: Length of one raw stock bar

parameters.name: waste_penalty
parameters.description: Unit penalty applied to total waste if waste is monetized

parameters.name: piece_length
parameters.description: Required length of each piece type

parameters.name: demand_quantity
parameters.description: Demand quantity for each piece type

parameters.name: pattern_piece_count
parameters.description: Number of pieces of each type cut from one raw bar under each feasible cutting pattern

parameters.name: pattern_waste
parameters.description: Waste generated by one raw bar under each feasible cutting pattern

variables.name: bars_used_by_pattern
variables.description: Number of raw bars cut according to each feasible cutting pattern

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Total number of pieces produced for each piece type by the selected patterns

variables.name: total_waste
variables.description: Total waste of the cutting plan

constraints.name: demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: Produced quantity for each piece type must cover its demand

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_bars_used
constraints.description: Number of raw bars assigned to each feasible cutting pattern must be a nonnegative integer

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_production
constraints.description: Total produced quantity for each piece type must be a nonnegative integer

constraints.name: pattern_length_feasibility
constraints.description: Each cutting pattern may use no more total piece length than the raw stock bar length

constraints.name: pattern_waste_definition
constraints.description: Waste for each feasible pattern is the unused length remaining after cutting one raw bar

constraints.name: total_waste_aggregation
constraints.description: Total waste is the sum of waste over all used raw bars

constraints.name: production_definition
constraints.description: Total produced quantity for each piece type equals the sum of pieces contributed by all selected patterns

objectives.name: total_waste_minimization
objectives.description: minimize total waste across all used raw bars; equivalently minimize the waste penalty if waste is monetized

final_objective.description: Minimize total waste generated by the selected cutting patterns. The scalar total waste variable Z is minimized directly as the single objective.
